meta.dataset_notice: Fictional procedural faces and scenes for pipeline-functionality testing only.
meta.quality_limitations: Face-crop quality combines Laplacian variance, mean intensity, contrast, detected face bbox size, five-landmark visibility and uncalibrated geometric pose proxies. Occlusion is a review flag, not a mask/helmet/cap classifier. Scores measure crop usability only and are not probabilities of identity or correctness.
meta.disclaimer: Candidate-only CV benchmark on synthetic/sample assets. No identity confirmation. Not real-world accuracy evidence.

environment.peak_rss_note: macOS ru_maxrss bytes; Linux ru_maxrss KiB*1024; best-effort process peak, includes test/runtime overhead.

yunet.license: MIT weights; OpenCV Zoo Apache-2.0 repository
yunet.purpose: Face detection and five facial landmarks
yunet.notes: Dynamic input shape, compatible with OpenCV 5.x DNN ONNX loading. Upstream GitHub file revision: 26cc381e4d2594bb9f47a26eb8fd96c94a13660d.

sface.purpose: 128-dimensional face descriptors for candidate ranking only
sface.notes: Descriptors are L2-normalized before storage and comparison. Pinned Hugging Face revision: 3d7082438a6e4551e840c9b2bb60b71e8da4b524.

yolox.notes: YOLOX-s variant with 640x640 letterboxed input; only class 0 is retained. Pinned Hugging Face revision: 78c368f74ce73ee28fc7a1be418a598c71b58b52.

challenges.note: Frame-presence metric using manifest labels; not box-level IoU mAP. Multi-face frame counted as present if any face detected.

subject_a_front.note: Uses manifest face-presence labels as weak proxy for person presence in synthetic clips; YOLOX person GT boxes/tracks unavailable. Treat as heuristic, not person detector accuracy.

notes: Box-level precision/recall/mAP NOT_ASSESSABLE: manifest provides frame labels, not bounding boxes.
Person metrics are heuristic proxies only where synthetic labels are used as presence proxy.

Only clips with labels and embeddings contribute; missing labels/pairs are excluded and reported.

ranking_methodology.label_matching: set intersection across comma-separated synthetic labels
ranking_methodology.note: Query-clip embeddings and all samples from the query clip are excluded from the gallery. This is a cross-pose synthetic smoke test, not a real-world accuracy estimate. Labels are applied only after ranking for post-ranking evaluation.

historical_reference.note: Historical artifact from previous benchmark script run; not regenerated in this task.

published_upstream_claims.note: Not measured locally in this run. See docs/CV_MODEL_SELECTION.md and model cards/papers for upstream claims; treat as non-local evidence.
